language: Egyptian (Early and Classical Middle Egyptian), middle hieratic book hand; black ink with red rubrics. Transcription is Egyptological transliteration from the TLA corpus edition; translation is English (Leipzig papyrusebers.de, with documented exceptions).

regions.text: jri̯ m (j)ḫ.t wꜥ.t wnm dp-ꜥ sḏr
regions.translation: are mixed together and eaten before going to bed.

regions.text: k.t jns.t rʾ-8 d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 mꜣt.t-mḥ(.wj).t mḥ(.wj).t rʾ-32 qsn.tj rʾ-32 ⸮〈mw〉? bj.t 1/16 jꜣrr(.wt) rʾ-32 wꜥḥ rʾ-16 tʾ n nbs rʾ-16 jbw rʾ-32 šꜣ.w rʾ-16 ꜥtḫ zwr dp-ꜥ sḏr
regions.translation: Another: nśt 4 ro, figs 4 ro, celery from the north 1 ro, ḳśntj 1 ro, honey 20 ro, grapes 1 ro, manna 2 ro, bread of zizyphus- fruit 2 ro, bw 1 ro, coriander 2 ro, are strained and taken before going to bed (footnote: Here a cross indicates that the last line of column 45 and the first line of column 46 are to be inserted in this place.).

regions.text: k.t n.t dr ꜥꜣꜥ ḥr ḥꜣ.tj dr mh.t-((jb)) wꜥr-jb dm.wt-jb jns.t rʾ-8 d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 mꜣt.t rʾ-16 ztj rʾ-32 šꜣšꜣ rʾ-8 bj.t rʾ-32 mw 1/32 mj.tt
regions.translation: Another to expel hæmaturia in the heart, expel forgetfulness, fleeing and injury of the mind: nśt 4 ro, figs 4 ro, celery 2 ro, yellow ochre 1 ro, šš 4 ro, honey 1 ro, water 10 ro, likewise.

regions.text: k.t jꜣrr(.wt) rʾ-16 wꜥḥ rʾ-8 tʾ n nbs rʾ-16 jbw rʾ-16 mꜣt.t ((rʾ-32)) [[jns.t]] [[rʾ-16]] mw 1/32 mj.tt
regions.translation: Another: grapes 2 ro, manna 4 ro, bread of zizyphus-fruit 2 ro, bw 2 ro, celery 1 ro, nśt 2 ro, water 10 ro, likewise.

regions.text: ḥr.w. PL -ꜥ n dr ꜥꜣꜥ n nṯr n m(w)t sqr (j)ḫ.t nb.t d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 jšd rʾ-8 bj n sw.t rʾ-32 ztj rʾ-32 mw 1/64 mj.tt
regions.translation: Berry-juice to expel hæmaturia (caused) by a god or a dead man and smite all (evil) things: figs 4 ro, sebesten 4 ro, bj of wheat 1 ro, yellow ochre 1 ro, water 5 ro, likewise.

regions.text: k.t ḥr.w-ꜥ n srwḫ ḥꜣ.tj m wn-mꜣꜥ d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 ztj rʾ-16 qmy.t rʾ-32 mw 1/32 1/64 mj.tt
regions.translation: Another, berry-juice to treat the heart effectively: figs 4 ro, yellow ochre 2 ro, gum 1 m, water 15 ro, likewise.

regions.text: ḥr.w-ꜥ n dr m(w)t m ẖ.t dr ꜥꜣꜥ n nṯr n m(w)t wḫd. PL sqrj (j)ḫ.t nb.t ḏw.t mꜣt.t mḥ.y.t rʾ-32 wꜥḥ ḥsb nqꜥ.wt rʾ-8 d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 mm rʾ-64 šꜣšꜣ rʾ-64 bj.t rʾ-32 mw 1/32 mj.tt
regions.translation: “Berry-juice to expel “”the death”” in the belly, expel hrematuria (caused) by a god or a dead man and smite all evil things: celery from the Delta 1 ro, manna 8 ro, sycamore-fruit 4 ro, figs 4 ro, ammi 1/2 ro, šš 1/2 ro, honey 1 ro, water 10 ro, likewise.”

regions.text: k.t qꜣw n wꜥḥ rʾ-8 d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 jꜣrr(.wt) rʾ-8 jns.t rʾ-16 pr.t-šnj rʾ-16 gj.w rʾ-32 tpnn rʾ-64 bj.t rʾ-8 mw 1/32 mj.tt
regions.translation: Another: powder of manna 4 ro, figs 4 ro, grapes 4 ro, nśt 2 ro, pignon 2 ro, rush-nut 1 ro, cumin 1/2 ro, honey 4 ro, water 10 ro, likewise.

regions.text: k.t ((n.t)) srwḫ ḥꜣ.tj srwjj wḫd.w ztj rʾ-32 qmy.t rʾ-32 d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 wnšj gs 1/64 jšd rʾ-8 bj n sw.t gs 1/64 mw 1/32 psi̯ zwr r hrw 4
regions.translation: Another to treat the heart and drive away purulency: yellow ochre 1 ro, gum 1 ro, figs 4 ro, raisin 2 1/2 ro, sebesten 4 ro, bj of wheat 2 1/2 ro, water 10 ro, are boiled and taken for 4 days.

regions.text: k.t d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 bj n sw.t rʾ-8 bj.t rʾ-8 ztj rʾ-32 mw 1/16 1/32 mj.tt
regions.translation: Another: figs 4 ro, bj of wheat 4 ro, honey 4 ro, yellow ochre 1 ro, water 25 ro, likewise.

regions.text: k.t ḥr.w-ꜥ n sqbb ḥꜣ.tj d(ꜣ)b rʾ-8 jns.t rʾ-8 ztj rʾ-8 bj.t rʾ-32 mw 1/32 mj.tt
regions.translation: Another, berry-juice to cool the heart: figs 4 ro, nśt 4 ro, yellow ochre 4 ro, honey 1 ro, water 10 ro, likewise.

regions.text: k.t ((ḥr.w-ꜥ)) n{.t} dr ꜥꜣꜥ m ẖ.t m ḥꜣ.tj m wn-mꜣꜥ
regions.translation: Another, berry-juice, to expel hæmaturia in the belly and in the heart effectively:
